45. Composition vs inheritance

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Composition builds behavior by combining objects; inheritance creates a subtype
relationship. Prefer composition when behavior should vary independently and use
inheritance for genuine substitutability.

A checkout has a payment strategy rather than creating a subclass for every payment
combination.

Q: Is inheritance always bad?
A: No. It is useful for true subtypes that honor their contracts; composition avoids unnecessary
hierarchy coupling.
